description: Write, revise, and review technical documents so that the reader can act after one reading: a README, a how-to guide, a tutorial, a reference page, a concept page, a runbook, release notes, a changelog entry, a pull request description. The skill fixes the reader and the one job of the document, then writes in the active voice, where every verb has a named actor, looked up in the code and never guessed, and where every command and output comes from the repository. Use this skill whenever the user asks to write, update, improve, or review documentation or one of those documents ("write the README", "document how to deploy this", "review this runbook", "write the PR description", "escreve a documentação", "melhora esse README"), even if they never say "technical writing", and when another skill tells you to apply it to prose that skill wrote. Do not use it for a design doc, an ADR, a diagram, code comments, an email or a chat message, an explanation asked in conversation, or a request to run unslop by name.
